spx.label: SPX + SPXW

idx.label: All index options
idx.what: every index option on Cboe: SPX, VIX, XSP, RUT …

tot.label: Total
tot.what: every option on Cboe: stocks, ETFs and indexes

eq.label: Equity (stocks)

etp.label: ETFs
etp.what: ETF options on Cboe (SPY, QQQ, IWM …)

vix.label: VIX options
vix.what: puts vs calls on the VIX itself; read the other way round: few puts = VIX calls in demand = fear
